scenarios.name: Select and clear an entity in the model viewport

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace with no command or modal dialog active
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with an unselected visible front face
the user clicks the face
the viewport identifies the selected entity and shows a distinct selected state
the user clicks empty viewport space
the selection and its cue are cleared
the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace with no command or modal dialog active
`features/application/viewport-entity-selection/spatial-line-and-point.opd` is open with 3D Sketch1 visible
its straight line has an exposed endpoint
the user clicks the endpoint
the pick cue identifies "1. Point (3D Sketch1)"
a compact contextual toolbar appears beside the pointer
the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace with no command or modal dialog active
`features/application/viewport-entity-selection/spatial-line-and-point.opd` is open with the 3D Sketch1 line visible and unselected
the user clicks a span of the curve
the curve appears bright green
a compact contextual toolbar appears beside the pointer
the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace with no command or modal dialog active
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with an unselected front face
the user clicks an unoccupied region of the face
the face appears teal with a bright green boundary
the pick cue identifies "1. Face"
a compact contextual toolbar appears beside the pointer

scenarios.name: Open the context menus for a selected solid face

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace with no command or modal dialog active
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a solid face selected
the user right-clicks the face
a standard context menu appears
a radial shortcut menu appears near the pointer
the radial menu includes "Extrude", "Select Other...", "Select Tangencies", and "New Sketch"
the standard menu includes "Properties" and "Export Face As..."

scenarios.name: Clear an entity selection from empty viewport space

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is in the part modeling workspace with no command or modal dialog active
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a solid face selected
the user left-clicks empty viewport space
the entity returns to its neutral appearance
the contextual selection cue closes

scenarios.name: Pick a sketch point in the 3D viewport

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is editing a 3D sketch with no other command or modal dialog active
`features/application/viewport-entity-selection/spatial-line-and-point.opd` is open with the 3D Sketch6 point visible and exposed
the user clicks near the point
the pick cue identifies "1. Point (3D Sketch6)"

scenarios.name: Open sketch-curve context menus during a 3D sketch

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software is editing a 3D sketch with no other command or modal dialog active
`features/application/viewport-entity-selection/spatial-line-and-point.opd` is open with 3D Sketch1 active
its straight segment is visible and exposed
the user right-clicks the segment
a radial shortcut menu appears near the pointer
the radial menu includes "Create 3D Line", "Bend", "Three Point Arc", "Helical Curve", "General Dimension", and "Finish 3D Sketch"
a standard context menu includes "Repeat Construction", "Edit 3D Sketch", "Properties...", "Measure", and "Export Object"
the user presses Escape
both context menus close
